SELECT 
  recvday, 
  decisionday,
  CAST(decisionday AS date) - CAST(SUBSTRING(recvday FROM 1) AS date) as apt_days
FROM cases 
WHERE decisionday IS NOT NULL 
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN h1bdep = 'Yes' OR supporth = 'Yes' THEN 'Complex'
    ELSE 'Standard'
  END as complexity_class,
  COUNT(*) as application_count,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(decisionday AS date) - CAST(SUBSTRING(recvday FROM 1) AS date))::numeric, 2) as avg_processing_days
FROM cases
WHERE decisionday IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN h1bdep = 'Yes' OR supporth = 'Yes' THEN 'Complex'
    ELSE 'Standard'
  END
ORDER BY avg_processing_days;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN h1bdep = 'Yes' OR supporth = 'Yes' THEN 'Complex'
    ELSE 'Standard'
  END as complexity_class,
  COUNT(*) as application_count,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(decisionday AS date) - CAST(SUBSTRING(recvday FROM 1) AS date))::numeric, 2) as avg_processing_days,
  MIN(CAST(decisionday AS date) - CAST(SUBSTRING(recvday FROM 1) AS date)) as min_days,
  MAX(CAST(decisionday AS date) - CAST(SUBSTRING(recvday FROM 1) AS date)) as max_days
FROM cases
WHERE decisionday IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN h1bdep = 'Yes' OR supporth = 'Yes' THEN 'Complex'
    ELSE 'Standard'
  END
ORDER BY avg_processing_days;
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(decisionday AS date) - CAST(SUBSTRING(recvday FROM 1) AS date) as apt_days FROM cases WHERE decisionday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

GROUP BY
